title: Mkpụrụ Obi Na-eche Nche n'akụkụ Osimiri
intro: E nyere otu mkpụrụ obi dị obere ọrụ nzuzo, ka ọ nọrọ n'ebe dị anya hụ ka akara aka na-apụta n'elu mmiri. N'agbanyeghị na a hụghị ya na onye a na-enyo enyo, onye a ga-arụ ọrụ dị mkpa n'ịgbanwe akụkọ ihe mere eme nke mba.
clues: Nne m nyere m ọrụ, nke chọrọ nzuzo na nlezianya.
Anya m na-eso obere nwa m nwanyị na-efegharị n'akụkụ mmiri ozuzo ahụ, obi m na-echegbu onwe ya nke ukwuu.
Mgbe ndị mmadụ na-atụghị anya ya hụrụ ya, abịarutere m nso, obi gbawara m nke ukwuu.
Ahụrụ m otú ha si enwe mmasị n'ịchọ onye ga-elekọta ha, m wee nye ha ihe ngwọta n'ekpugheghị eziokwu ahụ.
Ntinye aka m n'oge mere ka mkpụrụ obi na-enye nwa ara laghachikwute onye kacha chọọ ya.
N'ogige ndị dị ike, m kwuru sị: 'M̀ ga-eduzi unu gaa n'ezinụlọ ga-azụ ya ma lekọta ya nke ọma?'

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: O jikọtara nwa ahụ na nne ya ọzọ
O zọpụtara onwe ya n'aka ndị agha Fero
A tara ya ahụhụ maka nledo
Ọ bụ ya duru ndị Izrel
outcome.answer: O jikọtara nwa ahụ na nne ya ọzọ

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
